title: Boss: a tiny web server's brain
summary: Parse, route and cache like a real HTTP server.

steps.title: The brain
body: You'll write the decision logic of a small server. Raw requests use `\r\n` line endings. Paste earlier helpers as needed.

steps.title: Route a raw request
prompt: Write `string Handle(string raw)` that returns just the status line of the response (e.g. `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`):
- path `/health` with any other method -> `HTTP/1.1 405 Method Not Allowed`
Ignore the query string when routing.
solution: bool hasHost = lines.Skip(1).TakeWhile(l => l != "").Any(l => l.StartsWith("host:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
if (path == "/health") return method == "GET" ? "HTTP/1.1 200 OK" : "HTTP/1.1 405 Method Not Allowed";
hints: Parse the request line, then look for a `host:` header before the blank line.

steps.title: Conditional GET
prompt: Write `(int Status, string Body) ServeWithEtag(string? ifNoneMatch, string currentEtag, string body)`.
If `ifNoneMatch` is `*` or contains `currentEtag` in its comma-separated list (trim spaces), return `(304, "")`; otherwise `(200, body)`.
starter: (int Status, string Body) ServeWithEtag(string? ifNoneMatch, string currentEtag, string body)
solution: (int Status, string Body) ServeWithEtag(string? ifNoneMatch, string currentEtag, string body)

steps.title: A shared cache
prompt: Write a class `HttpCache` for a CDN edge:
- `void Store(string url, string cacheControl, string body, int now)`: store only if the directives (case-insensitive) include `max-age=N`
and include neither `no-store` nor `private`. Expiry is `now + N`.
- `string? Fetch(string url, int now)`: the body if stored and `now < expiry`, else `null`.
solution: private readonly Dictionary<string, (string Body, int Expires)> store = new();
public int Hits { get; private set; }
public int Misses { get; private set; }
public void Store(string url, string cacheControl, string body, int now)
public string? Fetch(string url, int now)
if (store.TryGetValue(url, out var e) && now < e.Expires) { Hits++; return e.Body; }
template: Dojo.Eq("no max-age not stored", null, dojoC.Fetch("/news", 1));
hints: Parse directives the same way as in the lesson.
Count a hit only when found *and* fresh.
